rationale: Indirect lexical completion/assignment tasks, not personal favorite, identification, admiration, beauty, encounter, study, companionship, protection or reincarnation. Each family includes two paraphrases with three paired formats. All share animal-choice construct; no claim of semantic independence or representative natural-prompt sampling.
